ADHD organization hack that actually works: I use a 2-planner system to stop forgetting deadlines and avoid daily overwhelm. Month → Week → Day is the only flow that keeps my brain calm. 🗓️ Monthly planner: appointments, quizzes, group meetings, anything not fully in my control 📆 Weekly planner: flexible blocks so I can prep before deadlines hit 📝 Daily pages: only 3 timed anchors + micro-step to-dos for dopamine If you have ADHD, executive dysfunction, or you keep making to-do lists you can’t finish—try this. It’s basically an ADHD-friendly planning system that prevents “out of sight, out of mind.”  #adhd #organization #neurodivergent #planner #student

ADHD weekly planning routine that actually works 🧠✨ My everyday planner-> @Sugar Paper LA  If your weeks feel chaotic, this simple system helps you reset, refocus, and stay on track without overwhelm. Here is the weekly planning flow: 1. Brain dump everything on your mind 2. Pick a theme for each day of the week so your week has structure 3. Add your tasks into Google Tasks under each day or theme 4. Break everything into small doable steps 5. Time block your most important work so it actually gets done This is not about being perfect. It is about giving your ADHD brain a simple structure that makes the week feel easier to manage. Save this for your weekly reset and follow for more simple productivity systems for ADHD brains 💛 #ADHDPlanning #WeeklyPlanning #ProductivitySystem #ADHDTools #ExecutiveFunction
